font_policy.note: Agent derives best display/body/accent for the job, documents rationale in bible, reviewer approves. Never blocked on fonts.

page_design_rules: High-contrast color use: alternate Navy and Cream grounds; Gold is the accent and CTA color.
Each section is its own piece of art, like a fashion show: no two consecutive sections share a composition.
Image-led sections use the image at the wireframe's full slot width; no shrunken images floating in empty space.
The B masthead / CEO logo appears in the first viewport.

layout_thresholds.note: Item 15 (FIX-PLAN.md) defaults, read by scripts/validate_page.py. Values are the plan defaults, not calibrated numbers: calibration against Trevor's accepted live pages is pending under the Amendment 6 hold. card_grid_allowlist entries match a sibling group's parent selector, its structure signature, or both joined by a space. single_cta_design is the brand-declared exemption for the guide-prescribed single CTA treatment (Amendment 6, Item 15 delta a).

banned_page_patterns: beige or off-white minimalism outside the Cream token
small identical black rectangular buttons on every CTA
40% or more of a section's width left empty at 1440px
numbered black circles on a thin rail
warm amber 'cozy shop' stock look (wood counters, Edison bulbs, kraft boxes, coffee-and-keys flat-lays)
